no_new_call_note: No call is live to review this week -- last week's copper call already closed. A scan across commodities, crypto and stocks turned up nothing both new and confirmed by more than one independent source that the market has not already priced: AMD's slide on a short seller's China-firmware allegations is already being argued both ways by analysts and the company has already pushed back; the broader AI-chip selloff, the well-reported sixth straight year of a silver supply deficit, IEA and OPEC commentary on a growing oil surplus, weather-driven natural-gas swings, and this month's run of US crypto regulatory moves at the SEC and CFTC are each already reported and already reflected in price, so no new call opens this week.
